signals.name: state
signals.note: One-hot FSM — UNDEF catches all invalid bit patterns (3'b000, 3'b011, 3'b101, 3'b110, 3'b111)

properties.description: Reachability of IDLE from the current state. Holds in both bug and fixed at IDLE itself; the difference shows in `always_recoverable` below.
From EVERY reachable state — including after a glitch into UNDEF — IDLE remains reachable. Fixed passes because the default case in the case statement transitions UNDEF back to IDLE.
Baseline: all states have successors. Holds on bug AND fixed.
